title: Simple is better than complex
paragraphs: For long, I kept redesigning this website instead of writing anything on it. deleting css, html files and starting over and over again. As I started writing again, I realized that simple is better than complex. So this website is simpler than it was before.
Everything here is hand-written HTML and CSS. If you view source, that is the whole thing. I like that.

title: Picking Up a Pen After Ten Years
paragraphs: I used to draw a lot as a kid, then stopped. Coming back as an adult is humbling — my hands remember wanting to draw better than they remember how.
The fix has been small and consistent: one little sketch a day, pixel art or pencil, no pressure for it to be good.
